column1: # The tables are 'basically 2D data from Abbott & von Doenhoff with corrections for the actual Reynolds number'.
# Only alpha = 0..30 deg is published with flow physics (40-90 deg rows dropped); NO negative alpha published:
#   alpha -12..-1 deg are COMPUTED with XFOIL 6.97 (Ncrit 9
#   +0.0013 and cd scaled by 0.488 to join the table at 0 deg (see 'source' column;
#   raw XFOIL output in extraction/xfoil/). XFOIL gives cl(0) = 0.155-0.159 vs 0.16 in the table
# re = 1.5e6 is NOMINAL: the report does not state the Re; at 47.5 rpm the blade runs at Re ~1.1e6 (root) .. 1.7e6.
